name: Pozfrito
description: Fritos at the bottom, more on top, the walking taco eaten with a fork.
fulfillmentNote: No commissary path, market and trailer only.
longDescription: Fritos on the bottom and more on top, our answer to the walking taco, except it's a fork you'll want instead of a bag to eat out of. The corn crunch holds up surprisingly well against the broth for the first few minutes, which is most of the appeal.
